Rounding-boundary defect. f(1.5) = -0.625 exactly, so 'to 2 d.p.' is ambiguous (round-half-up gives -0.63, round-half-to-even gives -0.62). At the midpoint x = 1.5 an integer-coefficient cubic always lands on a .x25/.x75 boundary, so asking to 3 d.p. gives the exact value with no rounding.

opener_concept: A car is 20 km from home at 1 pm and 80 km at 3 pm. By common sense the student finds it travelled 60 km further over 2 hours, so 30 km/h on average. That IS the average rate of change: change in output over change in input, (f(b)-f(a))/(b-a), the gradient of the chord. An inline SVG distance-time graph shows the two points and the chord to scale.
